description: This file defines the AppLockManager class responsible for managing app lock states including locking, unlocking via biometrics, and requiring authentication when app returns to foreground. It's part of the security/authentication framework in the app.

classes.name: AppLockManager
classes.description: A final class conforming to ObservableObject that manages app lock state and biometric authentication workflows.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the app UI until the user authenticates.

methods.name: unlockWithoutPrompt
methods.description: Unlocks the app UI without prompting for biometrics, used after logout.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Attempts to unlock using biometrics or passcode asynchronously.

methods.name: lockAndRequireAuthIfNeeded
methods.description: Locks the app and requests authentication on return to foreground if app lock is enabled.
